name: vision
description: Vision tool plugin (R7): read_image reads an image from a local path or http(s) URL and returns its metadata (format, mime, dimensions, bytes, sha256 prefix) plus a base64 data URI for vision-capable models. MODEL-GATED: the tool refuses to run unless the deployment operator has declared the active model vision-capable (VISION_ACTIVE_MODEL inside VISION_MODELS, or VISION_MODELS non-empty with no active model pinned); with no vision-capable model configured the plugin is inert and returns a guard refusal. Pure python stdlib (no pip dependencies); images are never persisted beyond the configured spill dir, and large data URIs are spilled to a file whose path is reported first (cap + spill discipline).

config_schema.label: Vision-capable models
config_schema.description: Comma-separated list of model names that support image/vision input (the models that may consume read_image output). Empty = no vision-capable model declared, plugin inert (guard refusal). Example: deepseek-vl2

config_schema.label: Active model
config_schema.description: Name of the deployment's active model, if pinned. When set, read_image is allowed only if this model is in VISION_MODELS; when empty, VISION_MODELS non-empty is enough (operator declared the deployment vision-capable).

config_schema.label: Maximum image size (bytes)
config_schema.description: Largest image that read_image will read (clamped 65536-67108864, default 10 MiB). Larger files/URLs are refused.

config_schema.label: Inline data URI cap (chars)
config_schema.description: Inline result cap for the base64 data URI; larger URIs are spilled to a file whose path is reported first (clamped 1000-50000)

config_schema.label: Spill directory
config_schema.description: Directory where oversized data URIs are spilled (read_image_<sha10>_<epoch>.uri). Point at a host-visible path under the deployment data dir (e.g. /opt/omni/data/vision). Empty = system temp dir (omni-vision).
